topic.title: Preface
topic.shortdesc: This is a sample EPUB book demonstrating the Dita2epub transformation plugin.

body.p: Welcome to this sample EPUB book. This publication demonstrates the capabilities of the Dita2epub plugin for DITA Open Toolkit 4.3.5.

section.title: About This Book
section.p: This book serves as a test case for the EPUB3 transformation. It includes various DITA elements to demonstrate proper conversion to EPUB3 format.

section.title: How to Use This Book
section.p: Navigate through the chapters using the table of contents. Each chapter demonstrates different DITA features and their EPUB3 equivalents.
